title: Daily VMT
description: One row of Replica's "Daily VMT" dataset. Derived from the published schema table at https://documentation.replicahq.com/docs/daily-vmt.

geoid.description: The ID of the geographic feature in the selected geo breakdown. If the feature is a Census geography, this field will contain its FIPS code.

geo_name.description: The name of the geographic feature in the selected geo breakdown.

date.description: The date of the network link volume estimation underlying the VMT summation.

vmt.description: The estimated network link volumes within the geographic feature multiplied by the length of the network links within the feature.
